Workflow 3: Error Handler

Purpose: Catches failures anywhere in Workflow 1 or Workflow 2 and alerts the team immediately, instead of onboarding silently breaking.

Logic:

Error Trigger fires automatically when a linked workflow fails
Sends a Slack alert to #automation-alerts with the workflow name, failed node, error message, and timestamp

Linked to: Workflow 1 (Lead Intake), Workflow 2 (Client Booked → Onboarding Chain)

Also note: key external API nodes (Asana, Google Drive, Gmail) have "Retry On Fail" enabled, so brief, temporary API hiccups resolve automatically without needing a human to step in, this error handler only fires for genuine, persistent failures.

Depends on: Slack
